## Description

In dashboard_model.py, give NeedsYouItem the record type, full text, body, and the id of the work-item it belongs to (same slug or slug prefix, same effort; empty for effort-level questions). No goal-complete needs-you item (decision finished-effort-derived).

payload.title: Carry type, body and task on needs-you items
